# iosxe_voice_register_global (Data Source)

This data source can read the Voice Register Global configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxe_voice_register_global" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the retrieved object.
- `max_dn` (Number) Maximum directory numbers supported
- `max_pool` (Number) Maximum pools to support
- `security_policy_secure` (Boolean) Only SIP TLS registration allowed
- `system_message` (String) Define system message
